title: Administration
subtitle: Accounts, lab parameters, diagram and monitoring

confirm.title: Confirm the change
confirm.totpIntro: These parameters control access to the lab. Type your password again and a code from your authenticator app.
confirm.passkeyIntro: These parameters control access to the lab. Confirm with your passkey.
confirm.unavailable: An SSO account cannot confirm this change here. Sign in with the local administrator or an administrator account that has a passkey.

lab.intro: How Lab Console reaches the consoles: SSH jump server, the console server’s login, allowed addresses. A change applies to the next consoles opened, without a restart; lines already open stay as they are.

ssh.host: Name or IP address of the jump server.
ssh.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.
ssh.privateKey: PEM format (-----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY-----). Leave empty to keep the current key.
ssh.passphrase: Only if the key is encrypted.
ssh.hostFingerprint: "SHA256:…", as printed by ssh-keygen -lf. Strongly advised: without it, the jump server’s identity is not checked.

telnet.username: Empty for lines that only ask for a password.
telnet.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.
telnet.wakeIdleMs: Silence after connecting before one wake-up Enter; 0 turns it off.

consoles.allowedHosts: Comma-separated. A console elsewhere stays on the diagram but does not open.

lab.secretKept: set — leave empty to keep it
lab.saved: Parameters saved: the next console uses them.
lab.fromEnvironment: Every value comes from the environment.
lab.unreadable: These saved secrets can no longer be read (APP_SECRET changed): {fields}. The environment’s value is used; type them again.

problems.range_order: The start must come before the end.
problems.credentials_required: A password or a private key is needed.
problems.key_format: Unreadable private key (PEM or OpenSSH format expected).
problems.key_passphrase: The passphrase does not open this key.

proxmox.title: Proxmox
proxmox.note: For reference: the Proxmox module still reads these values from the environment. Its tunnel reconnects when the jump server changes.

diagram.intro: The diagram students open consoles from. An imported file is checked and kept as a version, without changing anything: preview it, compare, then activate. Every version stays available; “Roll back” restores the diagram that was active just before.

diff.none: No bench or console changes (only the drawing differs).

diagram.activateBody: “{name}” becomes everyone’s diagram, right away. Open consoles stay open.
diagram.imported: File checked and kept. Look at the preview before activating it.
diagram.rollbackTitle: Go back to the previous diagram?
diagram.rollbackBody: The diagram that was active just before becomes everyone’s again, right away.

switches.intro: Consoles that are not on the diagram (the benches’ administration switches), shown in the Infra section. Saved as a whole, used at once.

sessions.intro: Every browser signed in right now. Ending a session signs that browser out at once, with its consoles.
sessions.endBody: {name} will be signed out of this browser, their consoles closed.
sessions.endOwn: This is your session: you will be signed out.
sessions.endAllBody: {name} will be signed out of every browser.

audit.intro: Who did what, and when: sign-ins, consoles, administration actions. Newest first.

announcement.intro: A message shown in a banner to everyone signed in, right away, until you remove it or its time is over.

status.title: Lab status
status.subtitle: Health of the access chain and what is recorded
status.intro: What the server sees: the SSH jump server, the console servers behind it, and Proxmox. Checked every 30 seconds at most.

journaling.intro: What the platform keeps of what you do, and for how long.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.what: Sign-ins and sign-outs, consoles opened and control handovers, administration actions (accounts, parameters, diagram, sessions, announcements), with the person, the time and the address.
audit.kept: Kept on the server, one file per month, never deleted automatically; only administrators read it.

consoles.title: Console journal
consoles.what: What the devices print on the consoles opened from the platform, with who had the keyboard. Never what you type.

kept.one: Kept {count} day, readable by the participants, the team that held the bench and administrators.
kept.other: Kept {count} days, readable by the participants, the team that held the bench and administrators.

noConsoleJournal.title: Console journal
noConsoleJournal.what: This version does not record what the consoles print yet.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.what: Your session keeps your identity, your address and your browser; administrators see them.
sessions.kept: It ends after {idle} h without activity and after {max} h at most.

never.title: Never kept
never.what: Your passwords (only a hash), one-time codes, what you type in the consoles.

errors.confirm_unavailable: This account cannot confirm here: sign in with the local administrator or an administrator account with a passkey.
errors.confirm_throttled: Too many confirmation attempts: wait a few minutes.
errors.confirm_required: Confirm the change first (passkey, or password and code).
errors.diagram_doctype: Refused: a diagram may not declare a DOCTYPE or entities.
errors.diagram_no_device: This diagram has no device with a console.
errors.diagram_already_active: This version is already the active diagram.
errors.announcement_invalid: An announcement is plain text, 500 characters at most, for 1 hour to 30 days.
